title: What is_public means on a Service Edge group

prose.text: The is_public field is not the Public Service Edge marker the legacy reference described.

prose.label: Reading.
prose.text: {{is-public-is-group-setting}} Its wire form and Terraform default are in [[zpa.private-service-edges.client-selection:is-public-field]]; the console meaning is [[zpa.private-service-edges.client-selection:publicly-accessible]].

prose.label: Managed groups.
prose.text: {{managed-not-public}} Whether the Public tier appears as groups at all is open {{gap:public-tier-readonly}}.
The grace distance override of a closer Public Service Edge is [[zpa.private-service-edges.client-selection:grace-distance]].

checks.do: Whether the group is organization-deployed: is_public is that group's Publicly Accessible setting, so a group with is_public true is still a Private Service Edge group.
Whether a read-only group is Zscaler-managed, from the readOnly and zscalerManaged flags rather than from isPublic.
Which Public Service Edge a grace-distance group overrides: the nearest closer one, within the distance, per the Private group setting.

is-public-is-group-setting.statement: is_public on a Service Edge group is the console's Publicly Accessible setting of a Private Service Edge group that has trusted-network mapping; it does not mark the group as a Zscaler-operated Public Service Edge group.
is-public-is-group-setting.conditions: Inferred from the console label and the field description, which both describe access by users outside trusted networks; no source states that is_public never appears on Zscaler-managed groups. The link from is_public to the console setting is itself Tier B (client-selection:is-public-field).

managed-not-public.statement: Zscaler-managed groups are identified in the group type by readOnly and zscalerManaged flags, and the console's read-only rule applies to Private Service Edge groups managed by Zscaler.
managed-not-public.conditions: Inferred; the flag-to-behavior link is itself a Tier B claim.

public-tier-readonly.title: Whether the read-only rule applies to the Public tier
public-tier-readonly.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Private Service Edges that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be configured - the same read-only posture applies to the Public tier," and "a Zscaler-managed (public) group is read-only." The console sentence is about Private Service Edges managed by Zscaler. No source shows a Public Service Edge or group in a tenant's list. Resolve with a tenant list of service edge groups.
public-tier-readonly.blocks: assuming zscalerManaged groups are the Public tier
